title: Exotic Whole30-friendly Greek Cheese Tiropita
description: A malty, shaggy, and kid-friendly Greek dish featuring fresh mint, perfect for the Whole30 diet.

ingredients.name: Feta Cheese
ingredients.notes: crumbly, salty cheese, make sure its Whole30 friendly

ingredients.name: Fresh Mint Leaves
ingredients.notes: chopped, fresh from the garden or store

ingredients.name: Phyllo Dough
ingredients.notes: thawed, make sure its Whole30 friendly

instructions: Line a wooden board with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine Tepid Water and Flaxseed. Let it sit for 5 minutes to thicken.
Add Feta Cheese, Fresh Mint Leaves, Greek Yogurt, Salt, and Black Pepper to the bowl. Mix until well combined.
Unroll the Phyllo Dough and cut it into small squares.
Place a tablespoon of the cheese mixture onto the center of each phyllo square.
Brush the edges of the phyllo with Olive Oil.
Fold the phyllo over the cheese mixture to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Place the tiropitas on the prepared wooden board, leaving some space between each one.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the phyllo is golden brown.
